title: Multiple non-collision periodic solutions for second order singular differential systems with parameters
summary: In this paper, new existence and multiplicity results for positive periodic solutions of singular second-order problems under sublinear and superlinear growth assumptions at infinity are established. Two aspects of our results should be highlighted in comparison with the existing literature. On the one hand, they allow for the consideration of systems exhibiting mixed behavior: sublinear in one component and superlinear in another.
